accepts.description: Zero-signup web scraping, HTML-to-JSON extraction & compliance checks ($0.01 USDC on Base or 1 prepaid credit).

description: Fetch a public static webpage URL, strip HTML/navigation boilerplate, and return strict typed JSON matching target_schema in one atomic step ($0.01/call). Best for static HTML pages, docs, and articles. For React/Next.js/Vue SPAs, use extract_dynamic_url.

target_schema.description: JSON object defining desired output keys and expected types.

url.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS webpage URL to fetch and parse.

name: extract_from_url
